svg.title: Bulkhead
svg.desc: Bulkhead. Give each dependency its own pool of resources so one failure can't sink the whole ship. Step 1, One shared pool: Every call to a dependency takes one of 12 shared slots and frees it when the answer arrives. Step 2, A slow dependency sinks it: Recommendations hangs: its calls end up holding all 12 slots, so browse and checkout time out too. Step 3, Partition the pool: Split 5 / 5 / 2: Recommendations fills its 2 slots, extra calls are rejected, the others flow on. Step 4, Size it and pair it: A bulkhead caps how many calls wait, not how long: add a timeout, watch the counters, size by load.

g.text: Every call to a dependency takes one of 12 shared slots and frees it when the answer arrives.
Recommendations hangs: its calls end up holding all 12 slots, so browse and checkout time out too.
Split 5 / 5 / 2: Recommendations fills its 2 slots, extra calls are rejected, the others flow on.
A bulkhead caps how many calls wait, not how long: add a timeout, watch the counters, size by load.
idle: no slot is left to call it

worker pool · 12 slots, shared by every call
in use: C, P or R is the dependency it waits on
stuck: that dependency is slow to answer
a call holds its slot until the dependency answers
all 12 wait on Recommendations: no slot is free
